Example IdealAdaptorStanfit object

Source: R/S7-example-objects.R
example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit.Rd

Fits or loads a pre-fitted example IdealAdaptorStanfit model. If file is specified, the model is loaded from or saved to disk using fit_ideal_adaptor according to file_refit.

Usage

example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit(
  model_family = c("NIW", "NIX", "MNIX"),
  n_cues = NULL,
  categories = c("/d/", "/t/"),
  seed = 42L,
  staninput_control = MVBeliefUpdatr::control_staninput(),
  file = NULL,
  file_refit = c("on_change", "never", "always"),
  stanmodel = NULL,
  chains = 1L,
  iter = 50L,
  warmup = 25L,
  refresh = 0L,
  ...
)

Arguments

model_family

Character string indicating the model family: "NIW" (default), "NIX", or "MNIX".

n_cues

Integer number of acoustic cues: 1 ("VOT"), 2 ("VOT" and "f0_semitones"), or 3 ("VOT", "f0_semitones", and "vowel_duration"). Default: 1 (or 2 for "MNIX").

categories

Character vector of length 2 naming the categories. Default: c("/d/", "/t/").

seed

Random seed for reproducible data generation and sampling. Default: 42L.

staninput_control

Named list of Stan input control parameters created by control_staninput. Default: control_staninput().

file

Either NULL or a character string naming the file (without or with .rds extension) to load or save the model.

file_refit

Character string controlling cache behavior when file is specified: "on_change" (default), "never", or "always". See fit_ideal_adaptor.

stanmodel

Optional character string naming the Stan model. Defaults to "MNIX_ideal_adaptor_ideal_integrator" when model_family == "MNIX" and "<model_family>_ideal_adaptor" otherwise.

chains

Number of Markov chains. Default: 1L.

iter

Total number of iterations per chain. Default: 50L.

warmup

Number of warmup iterations per chain. Default: 25L.

refresh

Frequency of progress reports during sampling (0 disables). Default: 0L.

...

Additional arguments passed to fit_ideal_adaptor (e.g., sampler arguments such as control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)).

Value

An object of class IdealAdaptorStanfit.

See also

example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input, fit_ideal_adaptor

Examples

# \donttest{
# Fit a quick 1-cue NIX ideal adaptor (wrapped in \donttest for CRAN)
fit <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit(
  model_family = "NIX",
  n_cues = 1
)
#> Warning: There were 1 transitions after warmup that exceeded the maximum treedepth. Increase max_treedepth above 10. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#maximum-treedepth-exceeded
#> Warning: Examine the pairs() plot to diagnose sampling problems
#> Warning: The largest R-hat is 2.1, indicating chains have not mixed.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#r-hat
#> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#bulk-ess
#> Warning: Tail Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior variances and tail quantiles may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#tail-ess
fit
#> <NIX_IdealAdaptorStanfit>
#>   Model family: NIX
#>   Categories (2): /d/, /t/
#>   Cues (1): VOT
#>   Groups (3): no_exposure, left_shifted, right_shifted
#>   Draws: 25
# }
